name: Feed the Cycle
assumptions: Treated node C (owner `any`, `bf`→`gy`, thing `creature,planeswalker`, flag `target`) as the spell's printed resolution effect, even though the flow graph lists it as a second root rather than a step chained under A's `to: "stack"` resolution. There is no other node on the card that could cause it, and a plain instant's own printed effect doesn't need a separate `trigger` wrapper the way a triggered ability does — so reading C as "what this spell does when it resolves" is the only coherent way to get a complete card out of the given graph.

Treated node B (`self`, `stack`→`gy`, no flags) as ordinary post-resolution housekeeping (a spell going to its owner's graveyard after resolving) rather than printed text, since it carries no flags indicating a nonstandard resting zone (exile, etc.) or any other deviation.
notes: Real card (forge-model/data/feed-the-cycle.txt): '{1}{B} Instant — As an additional cost to cast this spell, forage or pay {B}. (To forage, exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food.) Destroy target creature or planeswalker.' The mana cost, type line, and the destroy clause all matched exactly — the examiner's reconstruction of nodes A/B/C is correct as far as it goes. The mismatch is a total omission, not a wording difference: the packet's nodes contain zero trace of the card's `K:AlternateAdditionalCost:Forage:B` keyword line, so the examiner had no way to derive the 'as an additional cost, forage or pay {B}' clause and correctly didn't invent it (its 'Could not derive' list is empty only because nothing in the given data even hints the mechanic exists — a silent gap, not a flagged one). Root cause traced in app/lib/forgeTranslate.ts: translateKeyword() (line ~1598) special-cases specific row.role values (Offspring, Equip, Enchant, Ward, TypeCycling/Cycling/Landcycling, Flashback, 'Job select', Chapter) plus a bare-keyword fallback for zero-param keywords (line ~1698); a parametrized keyword that isn't one of those named cases — which 'AlternateAdditionalCost' is, with params ['Forage','B'] — falls through to the final branch (line ~1708: `ctx.unmapped.push(`K:${row.role}`)`) and produces no node at all. This is the same 'silently vanishes, not even into an unmapped/coverage count in the way that matters for this card's edges' failure mode the surrounding comment on lines 1702-1707 explicitly warns about for other unhandled parametrized keywords (Class, Gift, Offspring before it was fixed, ETBReplacement). Fix needed: add a `row.role === 'AlternateAdditionalCost'` case to translateKeyword() that models the Forge Forage additional-cost keyword ('Forage:<manaAlt>' — params[0] is always the literal 'Forage', params[1] is the fallback mana cost) as a real cost node/flag attached to (or gating) the main `cast` node, distinct from SCHEMA.md's existing `cost:{...}` convention which currently documents only alternate-cost casts from a non-hand zone (flashback/escape-style), not an additional-cost choice layered on a normal hand cast. Also note registries.json's `actions` map (surveil-N/mill-N/loot/scry-N/job-select) has no 'forage' entry — forage's own compound cost ('exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food') is itself a combine-group of two sub-costs that will need either a new actions-registry entry or an inline combine-group on the cast node once the translator is fixed. This is a decomposition/translator gap (edges.json for this card never captured the keyword), not a case of the agent misreading sufficient data, and not clearly expressible in SCHEMA.md as it stands today either — worth a SCHEMA.md §8 note once the translator-side fix is scoped.
